onboarding.depot1Description: Complaint, Payslip, Leave, Administrative document, Other... each folder on the home page matches a specific type. Open the one that matches what you want to send.
onboarding.depot2Description: In a folder, the "Scan" button opens the camera: the document's edges are detected and straightened automatically, just like a real scanner. You can also add a photo/file you already took.
onboarding.depot3Description: A document with several pages? Add them one by one before submitting — they'll be grouped together, exportable as a single piece if needed.
onboarding.depot4Titre: Track the status of each submission
onboarding.depot4Description: Each submitted item shows its status (received, being processed, processed...) with a dedicated color, right in the "Already sent in this folder" list.
onboarding.depot5Description: The "Documents shared with me" section, on the dashboard, gathers everything a department has sent you.
onboarding.depot6Description: A message, a status change, a shared document... you're notified instantly (sound + popup + bell at the top of the screen).
onboarding.personnel1Description: Each category (home page) contains subfolders, themselves filled with documents. Click to navigate, like a regular file explorer.
onboarding.personnel2Description: At the top of the dashboard, this block flags documents that have been awaiting validation for a while or are close to their purge date — a glance is enough to know what to prioritize.
onboarding.personnel3Description: In a subfolder, the "Group by employee" button automatically sorts documents by the person concerned — handy when several individual folders get mixed up.
onboarding.personnel4Description: Each document shows a colored border based on its status. You can move it forward (forward, approve, archive directly...) from its detail page.
onboarding.personnel5Description: A folder's "Download" button prepares a ZIP archive in the background and notifies you as soon as it's ready — no need to wait around.
onboarding.personnel6Description: A submitted document, a share, a ready export... you're notified instantly (sound + popup + bell at the top of the screen).
